map.新鲜度综合得分 = 外观（0 至 3）+ 气味（0 至 3）+ 质地（0 至 3: Overall freshness score = appearance (0 to 3) + odor (0 to 3) + texture (0 to 3) − temperature and time penalty; each 5 ℃ above the suitable storage temperature costs 1 point; remaining shelf life = base shelf life × score factor × (1 − time already stored ÷ base shelf life), and when the temperature is above 10 ℃ apply accelerated decay for refrigerated goods then multiply by 0.5; an overall score of 7 or above is fresh, 4 to 6 is sub-fresh, and below 4 is not fresh and must be removed from the shelf.
map.📚 深度解析：生鲜新鲜度检测与货架期估算: 📚 Deep dive: Fresh Produce Freshness Inspection and Shelf Life Estimation
map.到货品控：叶菜/水果/鲜肉/水产到库时按温度、外观、气味、质地四项 10 分制打: Incoming quality control: score leaf vegetables / fruits / fresh meat / seafood on arrival on temperature, appearance, odor and texture on a 10-point scale each, automatically rating freshness and estimating remaining shelf life.
map.冷链核查：温度超标（如叶菜>2℃、水产>0℃）会显著扣温度分并缩短预估货架期，用: Cold chain verification: temperature violations (e.g. leaf vegetables >2℃, seafood >0℃) significantly cut the temperature score and shorten estimated shelf life, used to judge whether the cold chain broke.
map.陈列管理：结合已存放时长，对临期（剩余货架期偏短）商品优先促销或下架，降低报损。: Display management: combined with time already stored, prioritize promotions or removal for near-expiry items (short remaining shelf life) to reduce spoilage loss.
map.温度分 ts：实测温≤品类上限 tl 得 10，≤tl+4 得 5，否则 2；综: Temperature score ts: measured temp ≤ category limit tl scores 10, ≤tl+4 scores 5, otherwise 2; overall score avg=(appearance+odor+texture+temperature score)/4; grade: avg≥8 grade 1 (fresh), ≥6 grade 2 (fairly fresh), ≥4 grade 3 (average), otherwise unqualified; temperature factor tf: temp ≤tl is 1, ≤tl+4 is 0.8, otherwise 0.3; remaining shelf life = max(0, round((category max shelf hours ms − hours already stored)×tf)). Category limits / max shelf: leafy vegetables 2℃/72h, fruits 5℃/168h, fresh meat 2℃/48h, seafood 0℃/24h.
map.叶菜类、实测温 4℃、已存放 24h、外观 8、气味 8、质地 7：tl=2，4: Leafy vegetables, measured temp 4℃, stored 24h, appearance 8, odor 8, texture 7: tl=2, 4>2 and ≤6 → temperature score 5; avg=(8+8+7+5)/4=7.0 → grade 2 (fairly fresh); tf=0.8; remaining shelf life = round((72−24)×0.8)=round(38.4)=38 hours. If the temperature rises to 8℃ (>tl+4), the temperature score drops to 2, tf=0.3, and remaining shelf life is only round((72−24)×0.3)=14 hours, clearly shortened.
map.评分与 GB/T 31081 的关系？: How does the scoring relate to GB/T 31081?
map.本工具温度阈值与 shelf 参考 GB/T 31081《生鲜农产品配送服务规范: The temperature thresholds and shelf references in this tool follow the cold chain ranges in GB/T 31081 for fresh agricultural product delivery services, but the overall score is a demonstration model. Actual acceptance should defer to corporate quality control standards and sensory judgment.
map.剩余货架期为何随温度骤降？: Why does remaining shelf life fall sharply with temperature?
map.温度系数 tf 在超标后从 1/0.8 跌到 0.3，且已存放时长持续消耗 ms: The temperature factor tf drops from 1 or 0.8 to 0.3 once the limit is exceeded, and stored time keeps consuming ms; the longer the cold chain break lasts, the shorter the remaining shelf life. So testing on arrival and storing cold is what preserves shelf life.
map.生鲜品控依据GB/T 31081《生鲜农产品配送服务规范》: Fresh produce quality control is based on GB/T 31081 for fresh agricultural product delivery services
map.冷链温度关键：叶菜2-8°C，水果5-10°C，鲜肉2-7°C，水产0-4°C: Key cold chain temperatures: leafy vegetables 2-8°C, fruits 5-10°C, fresh meat 2-7°C, seafood 0-4°C
map.温度每升高10°C品质下降速度约加快2-3倍: Every 10°C rise speeds quality degradation by roughly 2-3 times
map.感官评分应由2名以上品控人员独立评定: Sensory scores should be given independently by at least 2 quality control staff
map.外观/气味/质地任一项低于4分应判定不合格: Any score below 4 points on appearance, odor or texture should be judged unqualified
map.生鲜商品品质评估工具，输入外观、气味、质地评分和存储温度，综合判定新鲜度等级并预: A fresh produce quality assessment tool that takes appearance, odor, texture scores and storage temperature, comprehensively rates the freshness grade and estimates remaining shelf life.
